text: DAO accountability comes from the recording mechanism itself: because all transactions and decisions are written to an immutable blockchain that every stakeholder can inspect, no single actor can easily manipulate or obscure organizational activity.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and the Future of Work (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900880

isBasedOn.name: Quantum Economy and the Future of Work

abstract: All transactions and decisions are recorded on an immutable blockchain, accessible to all stakeholders. This transparency ensures accountability by making it difficult for any single actor to manipulate or obscure organizational activities.
